test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Q sits to the immediate right of D. Only three people sit between Q and S, when counted from the left of Q. Only three people sit between D and C. A sits to the immediate right of R. How many people sit between D and R, when counted from the right of R?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table

1) Q sits to the immediate right of D.

2) Only three people sit between Q and S, when counted from the left of Q.

3) Only three people sit between D and C.

4) A sits to the immediate right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc640decf030f3a2381e85d938b5e22ec3c5f86b65e87703f7c9807c55fc1099.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9ccd74aaa2a2a854d0e2ff2a18755ff6728c713788bac22d66c6808080bab43.png] 

So, B will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60fc1eccc25f6dee9f7e2dc46b4f721b9f46c480a6d59efd69981415a691d72a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5f1d36af583b5acac01e9e7f83f3b2d62ca88386b2df2c76d8d3b13de4607c0.png] 

Here, Only **one** person sit between D and R, when counted from the right of R.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
